facts.text: Applicants to the Academy must receive an official nomination from a U.S. Representative or U.S. Senator from their state of residence.

sources.title: The 8 Steps to Admission | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
sources.quote: You must be nominated by a U.S. Representative or U.S. Senator from your state of residence.

facts.text: During Sea Year in sophomore and junior years, midshipmen are assigned to commercial U.S.-flag merchant vessels, visiting an average of 18 foreign countries.

sources.title: Sea Year | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
sources.quote: This phrase describes the Academy's Sea Year - a period in both your sophomore and junior years when you and a classmate are assigned to a variety of operating U.S. - flag merchant vessels to transverse the trade routes of the Seven Seas.

sources.title: Sea Year | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
sources.quote: You'll put your classroom knowledge to the test in a real-life environment - all this while visiting an average of 18 foreign countries!
